reason: E1 directly supports that reducing Hf increases strength and that LMD refines grains, but it only addresses a specific composition (Hf0.25NbTa0.25TiZr) and does not provide evidence for the proposed HfMoTaTiZr system (Mo vs. Nb) or for high-temperature (~1000°C) mechanical properties. The premise that LMD compensates for strength loss at ~1000°C is unsupported.
premises: Reducing Hf content can increase strength (based on MD simulations)
Grain refinement from LMD compensates for any strength loss from composition change
The combined effect yields lower density without sacrificing room- and high-temperature strength
